shellCommands.command:
node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Read the sequels too"}'
echo
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books
echo
ID=$(curl -s localhost:3000/api/books | node -e "process.stdin.on('data',d=>console.log(JSON.parse(d)[0].id))")
curl -s -X PATCH "localhost:3000/api/books/$ID/finish"
echo
curl -s "localhost:3000/api/books/$ID"
echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "index:%{http_code} " localhost:3000/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "book-page:%{http_code} " "localhost:3000/book/$ID"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing-book:%{http_code}\n" localhost:3000/api/books/nope
